sequence.description: Monotonic integration-event sequence for this order; gaps are allowed.

order_id.description: Canonical unpadded base-10 representation of the Order-owned positive int64 identifier. Consumers compare it as a string and never parse it into a JSON number.

items.description: Producers MUST NOT emit two entries with the same (product_id, sku_id): quantity carries the count. JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness on a key subset, so a consumer that receives a duplicate deduplicates on that key and keeps the first occurrence in array order.

variant_name.description: Purchase snapshot label. Use OrderLine.snapshot_variant_name; when absent/blank on a legacy line, derive from its stored snapshot_attributes (sorted keys, nonblank values, key: value joined with /, capped at 255 characters). Never read the current catalog. Null only if neither a label nor usable attributes exists.

product_name.description: Product name from the accepted checkout snapshot (OrderLine.snapshot_name), so Review can show what was bought without calling Order or Product. Optional only for compatibility with producers older than this field.

product_image_url.description: Thumbnail URL from the same snapshot (OrderLine.snapshot_image_url); null when the line had none.
